reason: The fence-first migration needs claim-bound control-plane fronts for replica list/revoke/unrevoke, pre-cutover unfence and the control-plane-certified migration-cutover policy. They live in one route module beside the existing migration-token fronts and reuse its claim read, the existing provider transport and the policy outbox. The provider gains one read-only crate-internal query for the current run's own revocations, which the cutover must name exactly; no new table, credential or generic adapter.
